transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom, my name is Lucy. How can I help you today?
Customer: I am extremely frustrated. I have been charged for international roaming on my bill, but I never left the country. This is ridiculous.
Agent: I am very sorry to hear about this billing error, I understand how upsetting it is to see unexpected charges. Before we look into this, could you please provide your account number?
Customer: My account number is 42760619.
Agent: Thank you. For security, could you please confirm your full name, phone number, and email address?
Customer: Yes, it is Anjali Nair, my phone number is 93065 95549, and my email is anjali.53@examplemail.com.
Agent: Thank you for confirming those details. I have reviewed your account and I can see the roaming charges were applied in error. I will raise a refund request for the wrong charge now.
Agent: Please note that this refund is subject to approval and will be processed within 7-10 business days.
Agent: I'll make sure you're never charged for roaming again.
Customer: That is a relief to hear, thank you for sorting that out for me.
Agent: You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Customer: No, that is all, thank you.
Agent: Perfect. To summarize, I have submitted the refund request for your roaming charges, which you will see within 7-10 business days, and I have updated your account to prevent future roaming fees. Thank you for choosing Nimbus Telecom and have a wonderful day.
